The '''Jewel District''' was the wealthiest of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport's]] neighborhoods. The district had heavy security, and one required a permit or invitation to enter. Unlike the rest of the [[City/Legends|city]], the Jewel District was well-planned out in advance.<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen" />
